name: Time Blocking Basics
instructions: Assign every task a specific block of time on your calendar instead of an open-ended to-do list.
Block time for deep work, meetings, and even breaks -- if it is not on the calendar, it competes with everything else for your attention.
Leave 10-15% of your day unscheduled as a buffer; a fully packed calendar breaks the first time something runs long.
Watch today's video for a full beginner's guide to time blocking.
